_guide: People you meet: traders who swap, give or take things, and chance meetings on new worlds.
traders: id (lowercase, never reused), ic (an emoji), name (as it reads in a sentence: "a passing tinker", "the locals"), plural (true for "the locals", false for "a tinker"),
wants: tags they like (they ask for something of yours with one of these), when (optional, like line conditions; ground, water, temp, life go 0 to 1).
Lines: {trader} is them. {want} is the thing of yours they'd like, {give} what they offer, {crew} whoever has it (or you).
trade_offer: they ask (the player then says yes or no). trade_done: you said yes. trade_decline: you said no.
trade_gift: they just give you {give}. trade_lose: {crew} gives {want} away, as a small kind story (use "when" on want.tags).
For verbs after {trader}, use {trader:keeps|keep}: the first for one trader, the second for many ("plural": true).
meeting: chance meetings on a new world. Each one is { ic, title, text }. {world} is the world's name. Keep titles the same once used:

traders.name: the monks of a quiet monastery

trade_offer: {Trader} would very much like {crew}'s {want}. In return: {a:give}.
After a long, friendly talk, {trader} {trader:makes|make} an offer: {crew}'s {want} for {a:give}.

trade_offer.text: {Trader} {trader:keeps|keep} glancing at {crew}'s {want}, the way it catches the light, and {trader:holds|hold} out {a:give}.
It's cold out here, and {trader} would trade {a:give} for {crew}'s {want} in a heartbeat.
{Trader} {trader:has|have} heard music before, but never from {a:want}, and {trader:offers|offer} {a:give} to keep it.

trade_done: {Crew} hands over the {want} and gets {a:give}. Everyone looks pleased with the deal.
A handshake, a bow, and a laugh. The {give} is aboard now.
{Crew} says goodbye to the {want} and hello to the {give}.
trade_decline: {Crew} keeps the {want}. {Trader} {trader:doesn't|don't} seem to mind, and {trader:waves|wave} the ship goodbye.
"Maybe next time," says {crew}. Everyone shares tea anyway.
trade_gift: Before the ship leaves, {trader} {trader:presses|press} {a:give} into {crew}'s hands. "For the road."
{Trader} won't take anything but a story. {Crew} tells one, and gets {a:give} for it.
{Crew} helps {trader} with a stuck door, a lost goat and a long letter. Thanks comes in the shape of {a:give}.

trade_gift.text: {Trader} {trader:was|were} hoping someone would come by, and {trader:leaves|leave} {a:give} on the ramp.

trade_lose: {Crew} gives the {want} away to someone who needs it more. It feels like the right thing.

trade_lose.text: A child in {trader} is shivering. {Crew} wraps the {want} around them and doesn't ask for it back.
The way home for {trader} is dark. {Crew} hands over the {want} so they can find it.
{Crew} leaves the {want} as a thank-you on a little shelf of other people's thank-yous.
Someone among {trader} has a broken cart wheel. {Crew}'s {want} fixes it, and stays with them.
{Crew} plays one last song on the {want} and leaves it with {trader}, who can't stop smiling.

meeting.title: Research station nearby
meeting.text: A research station drifts near {world}. The scientists aboard are delighted to swap notes and very old biscuits.

meeting.title: A caravan passing by
meeting.text: A long caravan of cargo haulers drifts past {world}. Everyone waves. Somebody throws a bag of oranges across.

meeting.title: Space Diner in Orbit!
meeting.text: A floating diner circles {world}. The cook asks the crew to taste the soup, then asks again, just to be sure.

meeting.title: Space Lottery Ticket!
meeting.text: A ticket has been stuck to the hull since three worlds ago. It won something. Nobody can work out what.

meeting.title: Film Crew on Location!
meeting.text: A film crew is shooting a space opera on {world}. The ship ends up in the background of a very dramatic scene.

meeting.title: A pilgrim fleet
meeting.text: A fleet of pilgrims on their way somewhere stops near {world} long enough to wish everyone safe travels.

meeting.title: A field trip
meeting.text: A class of cadets on a field trip to {world} asks for a tour of the ship. They love the galley most.

meeting.title: A traveling orchestra
meeting.text: An orchestra touring the moons of {world} plays one song from their open hatch. It carries for kilometres.

meeting.title: A library ship
meeting.text: A library ship orbits {world}. The librarian lends the crew three books and says to bring them back whenever.

meeting.title: Amateur astronomers
meeting.text: A club of amateur astronomers near {world} invites the crew to look through their telescope. Everyone gasps at the same moment.

meeting.title: A painter on a cliff
meeting.text: A painter on a cliff of {world} asks the ship to hover still for a moment. The painting is lovely. The ship looks heroic.

meeting.title: Harvest time
meeting.text: Farmers on {world} are bringing in the harvest. The crew helps for an hour and is sent home with bread.

meeting.title: A traveling fair
meeting.text: A traveling fair is set up in orbit around {world}. The crew rides the slow wheel twice.

meeting.title: A radio show
meeting.text: A little radio station on {world} invites the crew to tell travel stories, live. Three people call in to say hello.

meeting.title: A lost robot cat
meeting.text: Someone's escaped robot cat is floating near {world}. It goes home very happy, and slightly smug.

meeting.title: An ice fishing contest
meeting.text: A fishing contest in the rings of {world}. The crew catches one frozen boot and wins "most creative".

meeting.title: A lost pilot
meeting.text: A rookie pilot near {world} has lost their way. The crew draws them a map on a napkin. It works.

meeting.title: A comet up close
meeting.text: A comet sweeps past {world} just as the ship arrives. Its tail is close enough to see the little sparkles.
